summary: Frontend-only testing of new LumiMorph Elite product page. All features working correctly: navbar link, hero video with play/pause toggle, before/after workspace images, 4 texture collections, installation section with diagram, 5 applications gallery, product specifications table with certifications, FAQs accordion, and CTA buttons linking to /contact. Page loads without console errors.

features_tested.details: Link appears with data-testid='nav-lumimorph', highlighted in cyan, navigates to /lumimorph-elite correctly
Video element found with source /artmorph-assets/hero-video-1.mp4, autoplay working
Toggle button works - shows 'Pause Video' when playing, 'Play Video' when paused. State toggles correctly on click
workspace-before.png (Display Off) and workspace-after.png (Display On) loading correctly with captions
All 4 collections found: Wood, Stone, Textile, Metal - each with image, title, and description
Modular installation diagram (installation.png) present with 3 features: Magnetic Mounting, Front-Access Repair, Easy Cover Swap
5 application images displayed: Hotel Lobbies, Corporate Reception, Restaurants & Bars, Retail Stores, Executive Offices
Two-column table with Display specs (Product, Pixel Pitch 2.6 MM, Brightness 3,800 nits, Pixels/m² 147,456) and Physical specs (Panel Size, Module Size, Weight, Power, IP Rating, Operating Temp)
All 6 certifications shown: CE, FCC, ETL, RoHS, CB, UKCA
5 FAQ questions found, accordion opens/closes correctly with chevron rotation animation
Multiple Request Demo buttons throughout page all link to /contact
'Ready to Experience LumiMorph Elite?' heading with room-setting.jpg background, Request Demo -> /contact, View Projects -> /case-studies
No JavaScript console errors detected during testing
